name: Rayon
product: Browser-based drawing/CAD software for interior designers and architects, adding 3D and AI features; over 4 million drawings created on the platform.
pricing_model: Freemium; free plan plus paid Pro/Team tiers (third-party listings show Pro around $21-27 per user per month); free for students.
expansion_signal: Funding earmarked to develop the platform and expand go-to-market activities.
africa_use_case: Freelance interior designers and small architecture studios in Lagos, Nairobi and Accra could replace pirated desktop CAD with a browser tool paid monthly in local currency.
notes: Clear self-serve monthly subscription for professionals; browser-based suits low-spec machines. Student free tier could seed adoption at African architecture schools.

name: bilt.me
product: AI-native builder that turns plain-language prompts into native iOS and Android apps, previews them on a phone and helps publish to the App Store and Google Play; exportable React Native code.
pricing_model: Freemium; paid plans from EUR 13 per month; enterprise tier with SSO.
lead_investors: Superhero Capital (with Markus Villig of Bolt and Martin Sokk of Lightyear)
africa_use_case: Non-technical African entrepreneurs could ship Android apps for local services (delivery, booking, church or school apps) without hiring developers, paying EUR 13/month via a local wallet.
founders: Uku Joost Annus (CEO), Kevin Akkermann, Karl Kiilaspaa
notes: Six-figure ARR, revenue doubling monthly for three months (per Invest in Estonia). Low entry price and Android support match Africa's Android-heavy market.

name: Guardio
product: Consumer cybersecurity service (browser extension and mobile) that blocks scams, phishing, malicious sites and AI-generated fraud, with identity-leak monitoring.
pricing_model: Free plan plus Premium subscription from about $9.99 per month (family plans available).
lead_investors: Not found (participants: Assaf Rappaport of Wiz, ION Crossover Partners, Union Tech Ventures, Vintage Investment Partners, Cerca Partners, Emerge Ventures)
expansion_signal: None stated (funds go to broadening its consumer protection suite).
africa_use_case: Mobile-money and online-shopping users in Kenya, Nigeria and South Africa face heavy phishing and scam SMS; a $10/month scam shield is an easy add-on to sell through a wallet.
founders: Amos Peled (CEO; co-founder list Not found)
notes: 1M paying customers and $150M ARR at a $1.1B valuation. Subscription auto-renewal model matches Cozzipay's recurring-billing feature.

name: Liner
hq_country: South Korea (also lists a San Francisco base)
product: AI search and research agent with cited answers, scholarly literature search (Liner Scholar) and writing tools, via web app, browser extension and API.
pricing_model: Freemium; Pro about $14.99-17.99 per month, Max about $29.99-35.99 per month.
lead_investors: LB Investment (with Atinum Investment, CJ Investment)
expansion_signal: Raising to scale its AI agents in and beyond South Korea and push into enterprise while growing its global consumer business.
africa_use_case: University students and researchers across Africa writing theses could pay a monthly Pro plan for cited literature search they cannot get from free chatbots.
notes: 14M registered users across 220 countries (daily.dev summary), so African students likely already use the free tier; card-free checkout could convert them to paid.

name: Good Tape
product: Security-focused AI transcription tool for journalists and researchers, plus Explore, which links a user's archive of recorded interviews to surface connections and contradictions.
pricing_model: Freemium; free tier with 3 transcripts per month, paid subscription plans (exact prices Not found).
round_stage: Seed (investment alongside management buyout from Zetland)
round_amount_usd: EUR 600K (reported by Inforcapital; tech.eu says undisclosed)
africa_use_case: African journalists, podcasters and academic researchers could transcribe interviews securely on a low monthly plan paid via mobile money.
notes: Used by about 3 million people in 150+ countries. Round amount only confirmed by a secondary source; treat as approximate.

name: Promptwatch
product: AI search optimisation (GEO) platform that tracks brand visibility in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and other models and drafts content to close gaps.
lead_investors: seed + speed Ventures (with Blum Ventures, Arches Capital)
africa_use_case: African digital agencies and e-commerce brands could track how AI assistants recommend them, starting on the $95 Essential plan.
notes: Passed EUR 2M ARR within 12 months of launch. Entry tier is at the top of Cozzipay's price band; best fit is agencies.

name: Birdsview (Avys)
product: Avys, an AI email-marketing and retention agent for online shops that writes and sends personalised campaigns and labels product catalogues.
africa_use_case: Shopify and WooCommerce merchants in South Africa, Kenya and Nigeria could automate repeat-purchase emails without hiring an agency.
notes: More than 100 customers and 52M AI emails per month (per a review site). Pricing unpublished; may skew to mid-size retailers.

name: RHISE AI (Lucie)
product: Lucie, a privacy-focused personal AI assistant that connects wearables, calendars and inboxes and proactively flags what matters.
lead_investors: Not found (40+ angels incl. Andy Bechtolsheim, Klaus Kleinfeld, Prince Max von und zu Liechtenstein)
expansion_signal: None stated (positioned as a European personal AI).
africa_use_case: Busy professionals in African cities could use a subscription personal assistant that ties together email, calendar and health data.
founders: Andy Loy (CEO, formerly Andreas Kunze), Danil Gontovnik (CTO)
notes: Early stage with a European sovereignty pitch; pricing and launch markets unclear. Lower priority.

name: Creedom
product: AI growth coach (Cree) for content creators that connects to Instagram, YouTube and TikTok, analyses performance and recommends what and when to post.
pricing_model: Not found (ARR about $200K reported by arr.club)
lead_investors: Leigh Hopkins, Raghunandan G, Kartheeswaran KK (angels)
expansion_signal: Plans to expand in the US with the new funding.
africa_use_case: Africa's fast-growing TikTok and YouTube creator base could pay a small monthly fee for data-driven posting advice to grow audiences and brand deals.
notes: Valued at INR 42 crore. Creator tools suit Cozzipay's creator and subscription pitch; Indian pricing likely low.

name: Miracly
product: AI marketing platform that audits a site, monitors visibility in AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini), writes and publishes answer pages, and automates PR, social and performance tasks.
pricing_model: Subscription from about $95 per month (per a third-party review).
africa_use_case: African SMEs and marketing agencies could replace retainer agencies with a URL-in, self-serve AI marketing tool billed monthly.
founders: Not found (built by The Wild Ventures, owner of Wild Palace)
notes: Self-serve URL onboarding. Price sits near the top of the target band.

name: Superpal
product: Autonomous AI coworker that lives inside Slack, integrates with 1,000+ business tools and completes tasks end to end (follow-ups, reports, lead work).
pricing_model: Not found (one-click Slack install, self-serve onboarding)
africa_use_case: Small remote-first startups and agencies in Lagos or Nairobi that run on Slack could offload admin and reporting to an AI coworker instead of hiring.
notes: Targets small businesses per L'Informaticien; pricing unpublished.

name: Serpier
product: AI marketing platform for e-commerce that automates link-building and content distribution and monitors visibility across search engines and LLMs.
africa_use_case: Online retailers in Egypt, Morocco, Nigeria and South Africa could buy self-serve SEO and AI-visibility automation instead of agency retainers.
notes: Small round; pricing and self-serve status unconfirmed.

name: Mio
product: Slack-native AI colleague that understands company context, handles recurring tasks and acts across 3,000+ connected tools.
lead_investors: Not found (investors include Fabric Ventures, Topology Ventures; angels Casey Caruso, Thomas Crow)
africa_use_case: Distributed African tech teams on Slack could use an AI colleague to keep documents, CRM and tasks updated without extra headcount.
notes: Exact announcement day not confirmed (sources cluster mid-July 2026). Overlaps with Superpal; pricing unpublished.

name: Display.dev
product: Publishing and collaboration space where AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) post HTML reports, dashboards and docs at permanent SSO-gated URLs for team comments and versioning.
africa_use_case: African developers and small dev shops using AI coding agents could share agent-built reports and prototypes with clients securely.
notes: Launched Display 1.0 on Product Hunt in November 2026. Very early; pricing unknown.

name: Hisabkitab
product: AI-powered cloud accounting and invoicing for small businesses: invoices, bookkeeping automation from bank statements and invoices, tax compliance.
pricing_model: Annual subscription; plans from INR 2,999 per year.
africa_use_case: African micro and small businesses could automate bookkeeping from bank and mobile-money statements at a very low annual price, if localised for VAT rules.
founders: Not found (company says it was built by chartered accountants)
notes: Product is tuned to Indian GST; Africa use would need localisation. Valued at INR 20 crore.

name: Heylist
product: AI-powered influencer marketing platform for nano-influencers that helps brands find and manage up to 1,000 creators at once, plus a Community feature to turn customers and staff into advocates.
lead_investors: Amiral Ventures (with Accelia Capital, Investissement Quebec, The51, Anges Quebec)
expansion_signal: Round supports growth in North America and entry into Europe, starting with the UK.
africa_use_case: African consumer brands could run campaigns with hundreds of local micro-creators, and creators could join for paid brand deals.
notes: Customers named include L'Oreal and KitchenAid, so it may skew to larger brands; one newsletter reports the equity portion as $2.2M.
